objective: Execute a general event/continuous-coupling prototype and measure the actual complete CNS, with code-producing ChatGPT review; keep biological equations and A/B/C alternatives.

alternatives.A: Globally coupled implicit residual, including non-diagonal mass and exact recurrence; retain previous negative cost evidence.
alternatives.B: Waveform/multirate coupling with model-declared event dependencies and corrected recurrent trajectories, reducing global work imposed by local events.
alternatives.C: Compiled effective operator/dependency program with persistent state and batched sparse products; retain ordinary temporal discretization initially.
alternatives.D: High-order explicit full-operator integration as additional rival, not parent/control.

selection: First inspect the actual operator and event propagation. Build at most2 complete numerical prototypes; a code-only abstract framework is not a completed milestone. ChatGPT produces runnable numerical code independently while local work extracts real dependencies.

criteria.events: Keep exact model-declared jumps. Do not identify absence of spikes with absent graded influence. Retain separate event timing/count diagnostics.
criteria.stage3: Speed target is operational, not biological. Passing a small fixture or peer agreement is not admission.

execution: One GPU load at a time. Exact new adapter baseline if compared. Freeze sources and parameters before each experiment, do not extend budgets after failures. No Codex subagents.
